module RecordLiteralWithStringTemplate

type Person is record
    name: String
    email: String
end record

procedure main()
is
    let user_name: String = "ada"
    let person: Person = Person {
        name: "Ada",
        email: String.template("${user}@example.com", user: user_name)
    }
    check person.email = "ada@example.com"
end main

end RecordLiteralWithStringTemplate
